title: Causally necessary persistent state under history-collision control
question: Can a learned stateful model retain earlier information that is unavailable from the current observation, and does that persistent state causally improve q2 prediction above the no-memory ceiling?
hypothesis: A residual state-writing PLM will learn to retain a prior latent bit across delayed observations and use it with a current bit to predict q2, while an exact reset/no-memory arm will remain at the 0.5 ceiling because paired histories share identical current observations.

benchmark.t0_observation: encodes memory bit m in text, image and audio
benchmark.current_observation: encodes independent current bit c identically across paired histories
benchmark.history_collision: for every current observation c there are paired histories with m=0 and m=1, so current observation alone leaves target probability exactly 0.5
benchmark.q1_action: not a function of m and is excluded from target generation

arms.name: persistent_state
arms.intervention: learned residual state write at t0, state retained through delay, current observation used at q2

arms.name: reset_before_q2
arms.intervention: discard learned state immediately before q2; use current observation only

arms.name: shuffled_history
arms.intervention: pair current observations with mismatched prior states across episodes

arms.name: oracle_memory
arms.intervention: supply benchmark memory bit to the q2 computation as an evaluation-only upper bound

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; delay-4 persistent accuracy >=0.90 in aggregate and every seed >=0.75; reset delay-4 accuracy <=0.60; paired persistent-minus-reset gap >=0.30 with bootstrap lower bound >0
decision_rule.licenses: bounded causal evidence that learned persistent state is required for the registered delayed task
decision_rule.does_not_license: general long-horizon memory, AGI, real-world persistence, or scaling

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but persistent criterion fails
decision_rule.licenses: persistent capability not established on this benchmark

decision_rule.condition: reset exceeds 0.60 or history-collision gate fails
decision_rule.licenses: benchmark is not isolating persistence and must not support a causal persistence claim

held_constant: same multimodal representation and residual state-write mechanism across arms
same five seeds, optimizer and training schedule
same current observations across paired histories
no q1 target or outcome information used to construct q2 target
memory bit independent of current bit
no post-run model selection or threshold tuning
leakage_rules: q2 target is generated from benchmark-side m and c only
current observation contains c but not m
delayed observations contain neither m nor target
paired histories share byte-identical current observations and differ only in m
all evaluation pools are generated from a distinct RNG namespace
